page.layout: One page of text, single column; faint show-through from the reverse side in the margins, not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: effundere. Jacere in lacrymis, Cic. Flere lacrymis argen-teis, Plaut. Indulgere lacrymis, Ovid. Indulgere luctibus, Lucret. Absumere lumina in fletus, Catul. Opplorare auri-bus alicujus, ad Heren. Effundi in lacrymas. Fletus ciere, excitare, Cic. Virg. Vid. Lacrymari.

Flere mortuum] Illacrymari alicujus morti. Collacryma-re casum alicujus. Lessum habere. Prosequi lacrymis abeuntem, Cic. Illacrymare alicui. Lugere fratrem adem-ptum, Ovid. Plangere aliquem, funera alicujus, Stat. Les-sum facere filio, Plaut. Plorare, Sen.
Fletus] Ploratus. Plangor. Ejulatio. Ejulatus. Collacry-matio, Lessus, Cic. Lacrymatio, Plin. Comploratio. Com-ploratus, Liv.
Flexibilis] Flexilis, Plin. Ovid. Lentus, Plaut. Vietæ virgæ, Hor. Vitilis vagina cucurbitæ, Plin.
Flexuose] Torte, Lucr. Intortius. Oblique, Plin. Vage decerant amnes, Lucr. Mæandri more, Col.
Floccus] Flocculus, Plin. Villus ovium, Col.
Florere] Florescere. Efflorescere, Cic. Reflorescere. Exhilarantur flore arbores. Pubescit virtus. Præflorere. Superflorere. Superflorescere, Plin. Vernant arbores, Plin. Vigere, Lucr.
Fluctus] Motus & agitatio fluctuum, Cic. Fluctus decumanus, Fest. Unda præcelsis crescit molibus. Montes aquarum, Ovid.
Fluentum] Agmen aquarum, Lucr. Impetus fluminis.
Fluere] Manare, Ovid. Scatere. Profluere, Cic. Volvitur amnis, Virg.
Fluidus] Fluxus succus. Torrens flumen, Virg. Profluens aqua, Cic. Manans, Hor. Manalis fons, Fest. Vivum flumen, Liv. Fons vivus, Ovid. Profluus amnis, Col.
Fluvialis] Fluvatilis, Cic. Fluviaticus. Rivalis alecu-la,

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is visible in the margins and was omitted. Some words in the first lines are slightly blurred; the reading follows the scan as closely as possible. The final word "la," is a catchword-like continuation at the foot of the page and is kept as the last line of text.
